svg.title: Flux component data flow
svg.desc: Snake pipeline: Row 1 left-to-right (write path) through Client, Gateway, Shard Worker, Kafka commands, C++ Engine. A vertical drop connects to Row 2 at Kafka events. Row 2 right-to-left (event path) through Kafka events, Shard Worker, Redis, Gateway, Client. A teal dashed arrow shows a direct read path from Gateway to Redis, bypassing Kafka entirely.
svg.text: dashed border = same service as row above
